title: Renderer foundation
choice: Evolve existing React/CSS, extract reversible rendering boundary; no mandatory Canvas/Three migration.

title: Responsive framing
choice: Adapt camera zoom across orientations; test 7–9 visible columns on portrait phones as a starting target.

title: Visibility
choice: Remove mechanical fog, reveal every in-viewport tile; decorative mist may not obscure interaction; validate difficulty.

title: Continuous directional input
choice: Hold/drag enables repeat of discrete atomic grid moves; hard-stop on release, obstruction, interaction safeguards, modal, completion; retain accessible keyboard and on-screen controls.

title: Playable-session official time
choice: Server-authoritative time starts from ready/playable handshake, not request creation; latency safeguards, retry/idempotency and historical compatibility required.

title: Deterministic generation
choice: Future date mazes reproducible by seed + version + configuration; historical stored grids immutable and remain authoritative.

title: Release calendar
choice: One new daily maze year-round; seasons shape aesthetics/events, not access; schedule and time boundary need engineering specification.

title: Archive access
choice: Every previously published daily maze remains replayable and catch-up eligible; no unpublished future access.

title: Reward eligibility
choice: First successful completion of each date per subprofile provides one collectible opportunity, including catch-up; replays give no additional item; protect all legacy awards.

title: Rarity selection
choice: Weight new-item selection by rarity among unowned items; guarantee novelty until exhaustion; disclose/test rates; no paid rolls.

title: Catalog exhaustion
choice: Award permanent full-collection distinction; no ongoing substitute item or currency once exhausted; preserve completed-at-catalog-version provenance.

title: Competitive ranking
choice: Permanent leaderboard per dated maze; catch-up and replay runs qualify; fastest valid time per subprofile ranks; preserve legacy records.

title: Expedition sequencing
choice: First major milestone: improved daily maze. Design extension boundaries now; implement authored expeditions in later milestone.

title: Future keyring
choice: Keys use level-local expedition keyring; one consumable equipment slot remains distinct; deferred until expedition work.

title: Collectible abilities
choice: Selected permanent collectibles may unlock optional utilities; assisted runs separated from standard ranked runs; no pay-for-power; server-aware verification; implementation later.

title: Initial achievements
choice: Launch 5–8 permanent achievements, extensible IDs; retroactive awards only from verifiable historical evidence; no competitive power.

title: Field Journal
choice: Curated Kearny museum journal, collection progress, anonymous undiscovered entries, illustrated detail, source-backed history, clearly fictional annotations, ability labels; incremental after visual milestone.

title: Historical research standard
choice: Historical factual claims sourced and editorially verified; enhanced Indigenous/sensitive-content review; separate Kearny fiction; preserve stable item IDs; withhold unsupported claims.

title: Narrative placement
choice: Environmental story, sparse signs, optional Kearny lore, deeper Field Journal and future expeditions; no required dialogue interrupts ranked daily puzzles.

title: Asset standard
choice: Approve polished representative scene then lock common art bible: projections, cell scale, lighting, anchors, occlusion, formats, test gates; renderer-neutral where practical.

title: Accessibility
choice: Accessibility in first milestone definition of done: input parity, reduced motion, readable/responsive UI, semantic focus/keyboard/screen-reader where applicable, WCAG 2.2 AA target for web UI with known limitations.

title: Program governance
choice: One cross-repo integrated GitHub Projects program; specialist roles, integrator dependency ownership, cohesive PRs, automated QA, independent review; owner signs product/release gates.
